author: opencode-worker-7
text: Timebox release by worker-7 after scoping (partial edits reverted, tree clean, lichen-core 391/391 green). The resolution is larger than one session because the density-high decision (>10, decisions.jsonl id=density-high, verify.grep_absent='Density > 8' in 02a) conflicts with the CURRENT state of the tree in three ways: (1) spec/02a still has 7x 'Density > 8' (2a.3.1, 2a.8 steps, floor c, 2a.9, 2a.10.3 consolidation, table DENSITY_HIGH=8); (2) vectors pin 8: ccp16.json timing_test (density=9 -> sf=11), ccp16.json density_high_ch0 (density=10 -> sf=11), ccp13.json dense_start_region0 (density=9 -> 5 permille); (3) my own earlier worker-7 commits (84add2fa04 C gradient 10->8, cf20fd33b5 Rust DENSITY_HIGH 10->8, both citing 'stale 2a.8') went the WRONG way per the decision and must be re-reversed. FULL fix plan: (a) spec/02a: change all 7 'Density > 8' sites to >10, table DENSITY_HIGH 8->10; (b) C: gradient.c:320 -> >10; link_ctx.c:651 -> >10; lora_l2_tx.c:421 adaptive_duty_permille dense tier -> >10; rf_health.c if it pins 8; (c) Rust: rf_health.rs DENSITY_HIGH 8->10 (main already has 10 via 3b250b1819 — landing that commit's state); (d) Python: ccp.py:105/:374 -> >10; link/adaptive_sf.py:138 -> >10 and remove the table shortcut at :129-133 (already reverted once); (e) vectors: regenerate ccp16.json timing/density_high cases (density=9 -> NO CH0, sf back to table), ccp13.json dense_start_region0 (density=9 -> duty permille per >10 table), ccp15/ccp16_load_balance density boundary cases; (f) tests: python tests pinning 9->CH0 (test_ccp.py:106), Rust adaptive_sf_density_threshold_is_eight -> _ten, C test_gradient_sf_density_threshold (my 84add2fa04 harness) expectations flipped back. Estimate: one full session. Related: b7z9.58 (closed cannot-reproduce — the bead was filed against the pre-decision tree), zzet (open — python dual-selector divergence).
